title: Shared full-DIO vectors omit explicit and malformed SCHC version semantics
description: Final Rule/version correctness review: test/vectors/rpl_messages.json covers only root/non-root current-v3 output and omits the advertised SCHC version field. Standalone rule_versioning vectors do not exercise full DIO serialization with explicit v2, missing, malformed, or duplicate options, allowing Python/Rust divergence and malformed Python output. Add independent canonical full-DIO vectors for current insertion, explicit mismatched preservation, missing handling, malformed length, and duplicate rejection, and execute every case in both languages.
